answer: To resist Sybil attacks, an AI economy can issue each agent a unique, unclonable walnut of trust. This credential binds an agent to a single persona within a decentralized orchard of validators. Each validator checks this proof, and the consensus forms a persistent echo of trust, preventing an agent from masquerading as multiple identities. Forcing attackers to generate these complex, individually validated artifacts raises the cost of flooding, making economic manipulation prohibitively expensive.
